hero.subtitle: WORLD CUP
hero.description: 32 nations. 1 dream. The road to glory begins now. Experience the largest football event in history across North America.
hero.cinematic_message: EVERY NATION ARRIVES WITH A DREAM. ONLY ONE LEAVES WITH THE LEGACY.

nations_list.name: ARGENTINA
nations_list.desc: Three-time world champions. The blue and white carry decades of football passion, technical brilliance and an unwavering will to win.

nations_list.name: BRAZIL
nations_list.desc: Five-time champions and the most decorated nation in World Cup history. The Seleção plays football like no one else on earth.

nations_list.name: FRANCE
nations_list.desc: Dual world champions who blend elite athleticism with tactical precision. Les Bleus represent a new generation of dominance.

nations_list.name: ENGLAND
nations_list.desc: The birthplace of football, relentlessly pursuing their second world title. The Three Lions awaken a nation united by one dream.

nations_list.name: PORTUGAL
nations_list.desc: Built on raw talent and collective spirit. Portugal channels the soul of a seafaring nation into every match they play.

milestone1.title: QUALIFIERS
milestone1.desc: NATIONS FIGHT FOR THEIR DREAM. ONLY THE STRONGEST EARN THEIR PLACE.

milestone2.title: THE DRAW
milestone2.desc: DESTINY IS WRITTEN. THE WORLD DISCOVERS THE PATH AHEAD.

milestone3.title: GROUP STAGE
milestone3.desc: THE TOURNAMENT BEGINS. 32 NATIONS. 8 GROUPS. ONE CHANCE.

milestone4.title: KNOCKOUT STAGE
milestone4.desc: VICTORY OR GO HOME. THE ROAD GETS HARDER. LEGENDS ARE MADE.

milestone5.title: THE FINAL
milestone5.desc: ONE MATCH. ONE TROPHY. ETERNAL GLORY.
